args.description: rises from a low crouch with a quick low horizontal cut of a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged forward at knee height, then back into the ready stance. The whole weapon stays inside the picture. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture.
